decisions.boundary_condition: Apply this only as a hotel-level amenity preference; do not retain destination, date, room, occupancy, or price details from individual trips.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize properties that provide a pool, a hot tub, and a fitness center.
decisions.exception_condition: Confirm with the user before relaxing the bundle when no matching property is available.
decisions.name: Prioritize hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness center
decisions.preference_value: Prefer properties offering all three amenities: a pool, a hot tub, and a fitness center.
decisions.rationale: Repeated dialogues directly support the same three-amenity hotel bundle. This is a durable hotel-search preference, not a trip-specific transaction constraint.

decisions.boundary_condition: Treat only the pool and exercise facility as durable hotel-level priorities; do not infer pool type, pool location, hot-tub availability, or room amenities unless stated for the current trip.
decisions.condition: When searching for a hotel, especially when comparing amenity packages
decisions.default_action: Prefer hotels that offer both a pool and an on-site fitness center or gym.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax either preference when the user explicitly waives it or stronger current-trip constraints favor a hotel lacking one of the amenities.
decisions.name: Prioritize hotels with a pool and fitness center
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with both a pool and an on-site fitness center or gym.
decisions.rationale: The evidence consistently supports pool and exercise-facility preferences, while hot-tub evidence is not uniform enough in this candidate to strengthen it into the stricter three-amenity bundle. It therefore remains a distinct, softer amenity threshold rather than being merged with that bundle.
